invariants.rationale: The method returns a map constructed via Collectors.toMap, which never returns null even if the input is empty.
At most one entry in the result map per element in the input list since Colllectors.toMap uses the key as the distinguishing factor, and duplicate keys replace previous values.
The method acts on data, which should not be null at method exit.
func is invoked on elements of data, so must not be null at exit.
parallelism is a parameter and used for configuring parallel operations; it is assumed not to be null at exit.
